muse_spark_1.3/001: Strategy: bitboard search with fast rotate-then-place generation, combined win+heuristic evaluation over all 32 length-5 windows, immediate-win detection, and time-limited iterative-deepening alpha-beta. Rotations are precomputed so each node needs only 8 rotates; move ordering by static eval with width limits allows depth 2 exhaustive and depth 3-4 focused search within 1s, always falling back to a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/002: The strategy is beam minimax with bitboards. The board is encoded as two 36-bit integers for speed, rotations are 9-cell permutations and wins are 32 masks for all 5-in-a-rows. The policy first takes any immediate placement+rotation that makes 5 while not giving the opponent 5. Otherwise all moves are scored by a line-pattern heuristic that rewards 2/3/4-in-a-row and penalizes opponent threats. Moves that allow an immediate opponent win are discarded as losing. Remaining safe moves are re-ranked by worst-case value after the opponent reply (min evaluation) and checked for forced win in 2 where every opponent reply still leaves a winning move. The best max-min move is played, always with time guards and a legal fallback.
muse_spark_1.3/003: The strategy is Pentago specific threat search with bitboards. The board is stored as two 36-bit integers, rotations are precomputed permutations and all 32 winning 5-lines are precomputed masks. Wins are bit-mask tests, evaluation counts unblocked 5-windows with exponential weights heavily weighting 4-in-a-row plus quadrant-center bonus. Play is: instant pure win first, otherwise iterative deepening negamax with alpha-beta. Child boards are built by permuting the existing stones once per rotation and OR-ing the placed stone, de-duplicated by resulting board, ordered by static evaluation and truncated to a beam to reach depth 3-5 in <1s. Opponent immediate wins are therefore seen at depth 2 and avoided, draws are preferred to losses, with time-out fallback to a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/004: The strategy is 3-ply minimax with bitboards, win masks, pattern evaluation and alpha-pruning. Immediate wins are taken, suicides creating opponent lines are avoided, all placements are tried with all 8 rotations deduplicated by resulting board. Static score counts unblocked 5-windows with exponential weights plus centre bonus, defensive weights slightly larger. Depth-2 value is min over all opponent replies with cut-off, depth-3 refines top moves by min over threatening replies of max over counters, respecting a 0.9s deadline with fallback to a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/005: The strategy uses bitboards with fast win and rotation tables, immediate win search, filtering of moves that allow an instant loss, static line evaluation and depth limited alpha-beta with move ordering and pruning under a strict time budget.
